stanza: To hike over the island to the village
And visit the marketplace
And enjoy the music and the food and the people
And do a little trading
And see the great ships come and go
And, man, have me a ball

q.line: You took your love to the marketplace
stanza: You took your love to the marketplace
In the wanton corner of a Western state
Where every other shopper is a basket case
Just realizing the horizon forms a frowning face
Hanging around those haunts at night
Where half the clientele was part poltergeist
Grinding an axe against all that exists
Minus their protected exceptions to it

partner.line: Where every other shopper is a basket case

q.line: Desmond has a barrow in the marketplace
stanza: Desmond has a barrow in the marketplace
Molly is the singer in a band
Desmond says to Molly, “Girl, I like your face”
And Molly says this as she takes him by the hand

partner.line: Desmond says to Molly, “Girl, I like your face”

stanza: Death's like a door
To a place we've never been before
Death, like space
The deep sea, a suitcase

q.songTitle: Car Wheels on a Gravel Road
q.line: Set of keys and a dusty suitcase
stanza: Can't find a damn thing in this place
Nothing's where I left it before
Set of keys and a dusty suitcase
Car wheels on a gravel road

partner.line: Can't find a damn thing in this place

q.line: I've been living out of this here suitcase
stanza: Been so long since I seen your face
Or felt a part of this human race
I've been living out of this here suitcase
For way too long

partner.line: Or felt a part of this human race

q.line: Death brought with him in his suitcase
stanza: Loneliness and frustration
We both came down with an acute case
And when the lights came up at two
I caught a glimpse of you
And your face looked like something
Death brought with him in his suitcase

partner.line: We both came down with an acute case
